text: For the choirmaster. According to Jeduthun (praising). A Psalm of David (beloved). 1 In God {Elohim} alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him.
He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress (height); I will never be shaken.
How long will you⁺ threaten a man? Will all of you⁺ throw him down like a leaning wall or a tottering fence?
They fully intend to cast him down from his lofty perch; they delight in lies; with their mouths they bless, but inwardly they curse. Selah
Rest in God {Elohim} alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.
He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress (height); I will not be shaken.
My salvation and my honor rest on God {Elohim}, my strong rock; my refuge is in God.
Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your⁺ hearts before Him. God {Elohim} is our refuge. Selah
Lowborn men are but a vapor; the exalted are but a lie. Weighed on the scale, they go up; together they are but a vapor.
Place no trust in extortion or false hope in stolen goods. If your riches increase, do not set your heart upon them.
God {Elohim} has spoken once; I have heard this twice: that power belongs to God,
and loving devotion to You, O Lord {Adonai}. For You will repay each man according to his deeds <Rom 2:6>.
